name: AudioPod AI
summary: A browser audio workstation for text-to-speech, music, stem splitting, transcription and noise reduction, with a free monthly credit allowance.
description: AudioPod AI is a browser AI audio workstation for podcasts and audiobooks, covering text-to-speech (200+ languages), music generation, stem separation, transcription, noise reduction and voice cloning. Official pricing: Basic is free, with 1,000 credits every month and no card (~3 minutes of TTS or ~1 minute of music). A 14-day money-back guarantee and commercial use on paid/PAYG credits are stated. The pricing page was marked last updated 13 October 2026 (slightly outside a strict 3-week window; TAAFT listed an initial release on 1 November).

pricing.details: Basic free (1,000 credits/month, no card); Creator 18 €/month (200,000 credits; official FIRST30 promo: 30% off the first month, 12 € then 18 €); Pro 45 €/month; Studio 89 €/month. Pay-as-you-go 1 € for 7,500 credits, never expire. 14-day money-back guarantee. Commercial use on paid and PAYG credits.
